subject: general
question: The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) was established in the year ______, under the Consumer Protection Act of 1986.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1988**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In India, the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC)** was established in** 1988** in accordance with **the Consumer Protection Act of 1986.**
 
• **In New Delhi,** it has its headquarters. A Supreme Court of India judge who is now sitting or has retired is in charge of the commission.
 
• **Justice R K Agrawal, **a former Supreme Court of India judge, is currently in charge of the commission.
 
• According to Section 21 of the Consumer Protection Act of 1986, the National Consumer must have the authority to hear complaints worth more than one crore as well as to appeal and review decisions made by State Commissions or District Fora, as the case may be. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• To safeguard the interests of Indian consumers, the Indian Parliament passed** the Consumer Protection Act, 1986 (COPRA).**
 
• The Consumer Protection Act of 2019 took its place.
 
• It was created to facilitate the creation of consumer councils and other institutions for the resolution of consumer complaints and issues related to them.
 
• The law was passed by the Assembly in October 1986, and it became effective on December 24 of the same year.
 
• **The law to the right was created prior to the COPRA act. **
